name: TC-1980: without HQ_OPERATIONS_NOTICES the Notices section is hidden and the API answers 403; with it, 200
description: HQ → Operations → Notices is gated by its own HQ permission. A per-run admin whose HQ_OPERATIONS_NOTICES is taken away gets 403 from /api/admin/notices and the dashboard shows no Notices (no Operations → Notices item, the section falls back); given it back, both open.
